caption: Linge harbour, Gorinchem
composition: Narrow town harbour and the church tower beyond the gables · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From a low bridge the Linge harbour in Gorinchem runs between brick gabled houses, with boats moored and the tall church tower closing the view. Terraces are empty after midnight. The sky is clear, about 14.0°C, with wind near 11.2 km/h. Sunset was 19:29. Hulls carry no readable names. This frame is the harbour, not the Dalempoort.
